newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips Q2 earnings more than double.
newsitem.headline: Philips Q2 earnings more than double.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday net profit from ordinary operations rose to 693 million guilders in the second quarter of 1997 from 304 million in the same period of 1996.
Philips said its total net profit in the second quarter jumped to 747 million guilders ($363.6 million), up from a loss of 456 million in the same period last year.
The results bettered forecasts by analysts, who had expected the electronics giant to report a second quarter net profit from ordinary operations of between 429 and 540 million guilders.
The company said the first half results indicated that the internal improvement programmes initiated in 1996 were on track.

It addded it remained committed to achieving the previously announced goal of double digit growth in operating income, a positive cash flow of over one billion guilders in 1997, and a 24 percent return on net assets in the longer term. ($ = 2.054 Dutch Guilders)
